```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)

plant_lep_df_raw <- read_excel(
  "posts/host-plant-lepidoptra-network/post_data/zookeys_-1261-101-s001.xlsx",
  skip = 1
) |>
  clean_names()
```

```{r}
glimpse(plant_lep_df_raw)
```

```{r}
plant_lep_df <- plant_lep_df_raw |>
  mutate(
    host_genera = str_squish(host_genera),
    ud_lep_number = as.character(ud_lep_number)
  ) |>
  mutate(count_host_plant_genera = parse_number(count_host_plant_genera))

glimpse(plant_lep_df)

plant_lep_df |>
  count(lep_family, sort = TRUE)

plant_lep_df |>
  filter(lep_family == "Nymphalidae") |>
  count(lep_subfamily)
```

```{r}
#top leps in terms of host plants
top_lep_hosts <- plant_lep_df |>
  select(lep_common_name, count_host_plant_genera)

top_lep_hosts |>
  ggplot(aes(count_host_plant_genera)) +
  geom_histogram()

top_lep_hosts |>
  filter(count_host_plant_genera == max(count_host_plant_genera, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
common_name_target <- tibble(
  lep_common_name = c(
    "Monarch",
    "Spicebush Swallowtail",
    "Eastern Tiger Swallowtail",
    "Virginian Tiger Moth, Yellow Woolybear Moth, Yellow Bear",
    "Fall Armyworm Moth"
  )
)

lep_range_state_province <- plant_lep_df |>
  select(ud_lep_number, lep_common_name, range_state_province) |>
  filter(range_state_province != "[strays]") |>
  mutate(
    range_state_province = str_remove_all(range_state_province, "&"),
    range_state_province = str_squish(range_state_province)
  ) |>
  separate_rows(range_state_province, sep = " ")

pa_lep_hosts <- plant_lep_df |>
  filter(lep_family == "Nymphalidae") |>
  #semi_join(common_name_target, by = "lep_common_name") |>
  semi_join(
    lep_range_state_province |> filter(range_state_province == "PA"),
    by = "ud_lep_number"
  ) |>
  #select(lep_common_name, host_genera) |>
  separate_rows(host_genera, sep = " ") |>
  select(
    host_genera,
    ud_lep_number,
    lep_common_name,
    species_complete_binomial_nomenclature
  ) |>
  drop_na(host_genera, ud_lep_number)

glimpse(pa_lep_hosts)
```

```{r}
network <- pa_lep_hosts |>
  select(host_genera, ud_lep_number) |>
  as_tbl_graph(directed = TRUE)

network

common_name_lookup <- pa_lep_hosts |>
  distinct(
    ud_lep_number,
    species_complete_binomial_nomenclature,
    lep_common_name
  ) |>
  semi_join(common_name_target)

common_name_lookup
```

```{r}
plot(network)
```

```{r}
network |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  view()
```

```{r}
network |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  left_join(
    common_name_lookup,
    by = c("name" = "ud_lep_number")
  ) |>
  ggraph(layout = "fr") +
  geom_node_point(alpha = .1)

network |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  left_join(
    common_name_lookup,
    by = c("name" = "ud_lep_number")
  ) |>
  ggraph(layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_bend() +
  geom_node_point() +
  geom_node_label(aes(
    filter = name %in% pa_lep_hosts$ud_lep_number,
    label = str_wrap(lep_common_name, 14)
  ))
```
